title: Fixed an issue where cells that were already drawn kept the previous type's alignment class and templates after changing the grid-level `type` with `updateSettings()`, and where the result cells of the `columnSummary` plugin became editable after an `updateSettings()` call with `cells` or `cell`. Passing `undefined` for `editor`, `renderer`, or `validator` now gives the option back to the grid-level type, so `updateSettings({ validator: undefined })` on a numeric grid keeps the numeric validator instead of leaving none.
